title: Best Article-to-Video Creators (2026): Turn Posts into Videos
description: How to hire someone to turn blog posts or articles into short videos: scripts, visuals, voice, formats, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Article-to-video creators turn written content, such as blog posts, news articles, reports or newsletters, into short videos with text, visuals, voice-over and music. It is a fast way to reach people on social media and video platforms with content you already have. Projects go wrong when videos simply paste text on stock clips, key facts are lost, or images and music are used without rights. This guide helps you get videos that actually communicate your article.

faq.q: Is it just text on screen?
faq.a: Good creators rewrite the article into a short script and match it with visuals. Pure text slides rarely perform well.
Not always, but voice-over or captions help. Many viewers watch without sound, so captions are important.
Stock footage, images, simple animation or your own media. Ask about licenses.

faq.q: How long should the video be?
faq.a: Short videos often work best on social media; longer versions suit video platforms. Ask for both if needed.
Often yes, to speed up work. Ask that facts and visuals are checked by a person.
